title: 第1085章 你该升仙了第1084章 神秘剑客
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
“阁下何人，为何来我月影宗？”、
看门弟子又问了一句。
白剑没有答话。
他脚步抬起，一步一步向前走去。
步伐不快，每一步都踩得极稳，脚下石阶无声无息，连尘土都未曾扬起半分。
值守弟子咬牙挺剑上前，刚要阻拦，一股无形之力便迎面压来。
他如遭重锤，“噗通”一声被死死按在地上，浑身骨骼咯吱作响就像背上了一座大山，憋得面红耳赤，半点也挣脱不开。
“块、快去通报宗主！”那弟子嘶声喊道。
另一弟子闻言目光在白剑身上一扫而过。
他咬了咬牙，只能将同门放在一边儿，掐起指诀，祭出飞剑，化作一道流光往宗主殿方向而去。
白剑恍若未闻，依旧缓步向前，衣袂在夜风中轻拂，径直走入月影宗山门。
他周身仿佛有着一股奇异的力场。
除了宗门护山大阵之外，月影宗内还有不少其他禁制，但都对白剑不起作用，随着白剑脚步踏过便纷纷失去效果。
有人入侵月影宗的消息传开，宗门内一众长老纷纷赶至。
这也算是一件稀奇事儿了。
现在月影宗是苍云第一宗，就算老祖被地星圣人封印了，还有那么多长老弟子在，哪个吃了熊胆的敢入侵宗门？
众人遥遥望去，但见那白衣面具客缓步踏空而行，周身气息温润如一块沉水碧玉。
他的灵力、神念、道韵尽数敛在体内，不漏分毫。
越是这般，众人心底越是发沉。
能踏空而行不露半分灵气波动，绝非寻常修士。

“何人擅闯我月影宗！”
苏祈年性子最急，一声厉喝，合体境巅峰灵力尽数爆发，掌风裹挟着凛冽劲气拍向对方肩头。
他出手留了分寸，只想逼退来人问清来路。
可掌风未至，白衣人只是抬了抬袖。
“噗——”
苏祈年身形骤然后飞，重重砸在山壁之上，嘴角溢出血迹，浑身灵力紊乱，竟连站都站不起来。
一招，镇压合体巅峰。
洞虚境镇压合体境也不过动动手指的事情。
但这白衣剑客不是动动手指。
而更像是吹了口气！
众核心长老心里有了计较。
来者不善。
修为绝对不简单。
“此人修为诡异，一起上！”
一名洞虚境长老沉声低喝，周身灵韵炸开。
content_en:
"Who are you, and why do you come to our Moon Shadow Sect?"
The gatekeeper asked again.
Bai Jian didn't answer.
He lifted his steps and walked forward step by step.
The steps were not fast, but each step was very steady. The stone steps under the feet were silent, and not even the dust was raised.
The disciple on duty gritted his teeth and stepped forward with his sword drawn. Just as he was about to stop him, an invisible force came over him.
He was pressed to the ground with a "pop" sound like a heavy hammer. His bones creaked like a mountain was being carried on his back. He was so suffocated that his face was red and his ears were red, and he couldn't get away at all.
"Hey, go and inform the sect leader!" the disciple shouted.
The other disciple heard this and glanced at Bai Jian.
He gritted his teeth and could only put his fellow sect aside, pinched his fingers, took out his flying sword, and turned into a stream of light towards the sect master's palace.
Bai Jian seemed to have not heard anything, but still walked forward slowly, his clothes fluttering in the night wind, and walked straight into the mountain gate of Yueying Sect.
There seemed to be a strange force field around him.
In addition to the sect's mountain-protecting formation, there are many other restrictions within the Moon Shadow Sect, but none of them have any effect on Bai Jian. They lose their effect as Bai Jian steps over them.
News spread that someone was invading the Moon Shadow Sect, and many elders from the sect rushed there.
This is a rare thing.
Now the Moon Shadow Sect is the number one sect in Cangyun. Even if the ancestor is sealed by the Earth Star Sage, there are still so many elders and disciples here. Who dares to invade the sect after taking the courage of a bear?
Everyone looked from a distance and saw the masked man in white walking slowly through the air, his aura as warm as a piece of submerged jasper.
His spiritual power, spiritual thoughts, and Taoist charm were all collected in his body, without leaking even a single trace.
The more this happens, the more depressed everyone becomes.
Being able to walk in the air without revealing any fluctuations in spiritual energy is definitely not an ordinary monk.
"Who trespasses on our Moon Shadow Sect!"
Su Qinian was the most impatient. With a sharp shout, all his spiritual power at the peak of the Fusion Realm exploded, and the wind from his palm slapped the opponent's shoulder with the cold energy.
He acted with caution, just wanting to force the person who came back to ask where he came from.
But before the wind of the palm arrived, the man in white just raised his sleeves.
"Pfft——"
Su Qinian's figure suddenly flew back and hit the mountain wall hard. Blood spilled from the corner of his mouth. His spiritual energy was in chaos and he couldn't even stand up.
One move to suppress the peak of the combined body.
Suppressing the Fusion Realm by the Dongxu Realm is just a matter of moving a finger.
But the swordsman in white didn't move his fingers.
It's more like a breath of air!
The core elders had some calculations in their minds.
The one who comes is not good.
Cultivation is definitely not simple.
"This person's cultivation is weird, come on together!"
An elder from the Cave Void Realm shouted in a deep voice, and his aura exploded around his body.
